titulo_es.@en: ask and deny in the past

titulo.@en: ask and deny in the past

texto.@es: En preguntas usa **Did + sujeto + verbo base**: **Did you visit the museum?**
texto.@en: In questions use **Did + sujeto + verbo base**: **Did you visit the museum?**

texto.@es: Para negar, usa **didn't + verbo base**: **We didn't visit the museum on Monday.**
texto.@en: To deny, use **didn't + verbo base**: **We didn't visit the museum on Monday.**

texto.@es: Tras **did/didn't** no uses el pasado del verbo: **visit**, no *visited*; **go**, no *went*.
texto.@en: After **did/didn't** do not use the past of the verb: **visit**, no * visited *; **go**, no * went *.
